- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices.readonly
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - location Id / company Id based on altType
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type
- status string - status to be filtered
- startAt string (e.g. "2023-01-01") - startAt in YYYY-MM-DD format
- endAt string (e.g. "2023-01-01") - endAt in YYYY-MM-DD format
- search string (e.g. "Alex") - To search for an invoice by id / name / email / phoneNo
- paymentMode string (enum: default | live | test; e.g. "live") - payment mode
- contactId string (e.g. "AmuzcoPBpgKeccNsFlib") - Contact ID for the invoice
- limit* string (e.g. 10) - Limit the number of items to return
- offset* string (e.g. 10) - Number of items to skip
- sortField string (enum: issueDate; e.g. "issueDate") - The field on which sorting should be applied
- sortOrder string (enum: ascend | descend; e.g. "descend") - The order of sort which should be applied for the sortField

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- invoices* object[]
  - _id* string - Invoice Id
  - status* string (enum: draft | sent | payment_processing | paid | void | partially_paid) - Invoice Status
  - liveMode* boolean - Live Mode
  - amountPaid* number - Amount Paid
  - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
  - altType* string (enum: location)
  - name* string - Name of the invoice
  - businessDetails* object - Business Details
  - invoiceNumber* number - Invoice Number
  - currency* string - Currency
  - contactDetails* object - Contact Details
  - issueDate* string - Issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format
  - dueDate* string - Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format
  - discount object - Discount
  - invoiceItems* string[] - Invoice Items
  - total* number - Total Amount
  - title* string - Title
  - amountDue* number - Total Amount Due
  - createdAt* string - created at
  - updatedAt* string - updated at
  - automaticTaxesEnabled boolean - Automatic taxes enabled for the Invoice
  - automaticTaxesCalculated boolean - Is Automatic taxes calculated for the Invoice items
  - paymentSchedule object - split invoice into payment schedule summing up to full invoice amount
  - totalSummary* object
    - subTotal* number - subTotal
    - discount* number - discount
    - tax* number - tax
  - remindersConfiguration object - Reminders Configuration
    - reminderExecutionDetailsList* object - List of reminders
    - reminderSettings* object - Reminder settings
      - defaultEmailTemplateId* string - default template Id of reminder
      - reminders* object[] - List of reminders
        - enabled* boolean - Flag indicating if the reminder is enabled or not
        - emailTemplate* string - Email template to be used for sending reminders
        - smsTemplate* string - SMS template to be used for sending reminders
        - emailSubject* string - Subject of the reminder
        - reminderId* string - Unique identifier for the reminder
        - reminderName* string - Name of the reminder
        - reminderTime* string (enum: before | after) - Time condition for the reminder
        - intervalType* string (enum: yearly | monthly | weekly | daily | hourly | minutely | secondly) - Interval type for the reminder
        - maxReminders* number - Maximum number of reminders that can be sent
        - reminderInvoiceCondition* string (enum: invoice_sent | invoice_overdue) - Condition for sending the reminder
        - reminderNumber* number - frequency gap of the reminder to exeucte
        - startTime string - Business Hour Start Time
        - endTime string - Business Hour End Time
        - timezone string - Timezone at which reminder will be sent
- total* number - Total number of invoices

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

      - count number - Max number of task executions
      - daysBefore number - Execute task number of days before
      - useStartAsPrimaryUserAccepted boolean - Start as primary user accepted date

POST /invoices/text2pay

Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/invoices/text-2-pay-invoice | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/invoices/text-2-pay-invoice.md

API to create or update a text2pay invoice

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) Text2PayDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - location Id / company Id based on altType
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type
- name* string (e.g. "New Invoice") - Invoice Name
- currency* string (e.g. "USD") - Currency code
- items* object[] - An array of items for the invoice.
  - name* string (e.g. "ABC Product") - Invoice Item Name
  - description string (e.g. "ABC Corp.") - Invoice descriptions
  - productId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Product Id
  - priceId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Price Id
  - currency* string (e.g. "USD") - Currency
  - amount* number (e.g. 999) - Product amount
  - qty* number (e.g. 1) - Product Quantity
  - taxes object[] - Tax
    - _id* string
    - name* string
    - rate* number
    - calculation string (enum: exclusive)
    - description string
    - taxId string
  - automaticTaxCategoryId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Tax category id for calculating automatic tax
  - isSetupFeeItem boolean - Setupfee item, only created when 1st invoice of recurring schedule is generated
  - type string (enum: one_time | recurring; e.g. "one_time") - Price type of the item
  - taxInclusive boolean (default: false) - true if item amount is tax inclusive
- termsNotes string (e.g. "<p>This is a default terms.</p>") - Terms notes, Also supports HTML markups
- title string (e.g. "INVOICE") - Title for the invoice
- contactDetails* object - Contact information to send the invoice to
  - id* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Contact ID
  - name* string (e.g. "Alex") - Contact Name
  - phoneNo* string (e.g. "+1234567890") - Contact Phone Number
  - email* string (e.g. "alex@example.com") - Contact Email
  - additionalEmails object[] - Secondary email addresses for the contact to be saved
    - email* string (e.g. "alex@example.com")
  - companyName string (e.g. "ABC Corp.") - Contact Company Name
  - address object
    - addressLine1 string (e.g. "9931 Beechwood") - Address Line 1
    - addressLine2 string (e.g. "Beechwood") - Address Line 2
    - city string (e.g. "St. Houston") - City
    - state string (e.g. "TX") - State
    - countryCode string (e.g. "US") - Country Code
    - postalCode string (e.g. "559-6993") - Postal Code
  - customFields string[] - Custom Values
- invoiceNumber string (e.g. "1001") - Invoice Number
- issueDate* string (e.g. "2023-01-01") - Issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format
- dueDate string (e.g. "2023-01-14") - Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format
- sentTo* object
  - email* string[] (e.g. ["alex@example.com"]) - Email Address
  - emailCc string[] (e.g. ["alex@example.com"]) - cc to be kept in any sent out emails
  - emailBcc string[] (e.g. ["alex@example.com"]) - bcc to be kept in any sent out emails
  - phoneNo string[] (e.g. ["+1-214-559-6993"]) - Contact Phone Number
- liveMode* boolean
- automaticTaxesEnabled boolean - Automatic taxes enabled for the Invoice
- paymentSchedule object - split invoice into payment schedule summing up to full invoice amount

PUT /invoices/template/{templateId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/invoices/template/{templateId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/invoices/update-invoice-template | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/invoices/update-invoice-template.md

API to update an template by template id

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices/template.write
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices/template.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- templateId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Template Id

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateInvoiceTemplateDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - location Id / company Id based on altType
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type
- internal boolean
- name* string (e.g. "New Template") - Name of the template
- businessDetails* object
  - logoUrl string (e.g. "https://example.com/logo.png") - Business Logo URL
  - name string (e.g. "ABC Corp.") - Business Name
  - phoneNo string (e.g. "+1-214-559-6993") - Business Phone Number
  - address object (e.g. "9931 Beechwood, TX") - Business Address
    - addressLine1 string (e.g. "9931 Beechwood") - Address Line 1
    - addressLine2 string (e.g. "Beechwood") - Address Line 2
    - city string (e.g. "St. Houston") - City
    - state string (e.g. "TX") - State
    - countryCode string (e.g. "US") - Country Code
    - postalCode string (e.g. "559-6993") - Postal Code
  - website string (e.g. "wwww.example.com") - Business Website Link
  - customValues string[] - Custom Values
- currency* string
- items* object[]
  - name* string (e.g. "ABC Product") - Invoice Item Name
  - description string (e.g. "ABC Corp.") - Invoice descriptions
  - productId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Product Id
  - priceId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Price Id
  - currency* string (e.g. "USD") - Currency
  - amount* number (e.g. 999) - Product amount
  - qty* number (e.g. 1) - Product Quantity
  - taxes object[] - Tax
    - _id* string
    - name* string
    - rate* number
    - calculation string (enum: exclusive)
    - description string
    - taxId string
  - automaticTaxCategoryId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Tax category id for calculating automatic tax
  - isSetupFeeItem boolean - Setupfee item, only created when 1st invoice of recurring schedule is generated
  - type string (enum: one_time | recurring; e.g. "one_time") - Price type of the item
  - taxInclusive boolean (default: false) - true if item amount is tax inclusive
- discount object
  - value number (default: 0; e.g. 10) - Discount Value
  - type* string (enum: percentage | fixed; default: percentage) - Discount type
  - validOnProductIds string[] (e.g. "[ '6579751d56f60276e5bd4154' ]") - Product Ids on which discount is applicable
- termsNotes string
- title string (e.g. "New Template") - Template title
- miscellaneousCharges object - miscellaneous charges for the invoice
  - charges* any[][] - charges for the processing fee
  - collectedMiscellaneousCharges number (e.g. 10) - collected miscellaneous charges
  - paidCharges object[] - paid miscellaneous charges
    - name* string (e.g. "Processing Fee") - name of the processing fee
    - charge* number (e.g. 10) - charge for the processing fee
    - amount* number (e.g. 10) - amount of the processing fee
    - _id* string (e.g. "673d01d7d547648a8dab6211") - id of the processing fee

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - Template Id
- altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- name* string - Name of the Template
- businessDetails* object - Business Details
  - logoUrl string - Business Logo URL
  - name string - Business Name
  - phoneNo string - Business Phone Number
  - address object - Business Address
    - addressLine1 string - Address Line 1
    - addressLine2 string - Address Line 2
    - city string - City
    - state string - State
    - countryCode string - Country Code
    - postalCode string - Postal Code
  - website string - Business Website Link
  - customValues string[] - Custom Values
- currency* string - Currency
- discount object - Discount
  - value number (default: 0) - Discount Value
  - type* string (enum: percentage | fixed; default: percentage) - Discount type
  - validOnProductIds string[] - Product Ids on which discount is applicable
- items* string[] - Invoice Items
- invoiceNumberPrefix string - prefix for invoice number
- total* number - Total Amount
- createdAt* string - created at
- updatedAt* string - updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Update template late fees configuration
PATCH /invoices/template/{templateId}/late-fees-configuration
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/invoices/template/{templateId}/late-fees-configuration
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/invoices/update-invoice-template-late-fees-configuration | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/invoices/update-invoice-template-late-fees-configuration.md

API to update template late fees configuration by template id

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- templateId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Template Id

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateInvoiceLateFeesConfigurationDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - location Id / company Id based on altType
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type
- lateFeesConfiguration* object - late fees configuration
  - enable* boolean - Enable late fees
  - value* number (e.g. 10) - Late Fees Value
  - type* string (enum: fixed | percentage; e.g. "fixed") - Late Fees Type
  - frequency* object - Late Fees Frequency
    - intervalCount* number (e.g. 10) - Late fees interval count
    - interval* string (enum: minute | hour | day | week | month | one_time; e.g. "day") - Late fees interval
  - grace object - Late Fees Grace
    - intervalCount* number (e.g. 10) - Late fees grace interval count
    - interval* string (enum: day; e.g. "day") - Late fees grace interval
  - maxLateFees object - Max late fees payable
    - type* string (enum: fixed; e.g. "fixed")
    - value* number (e.g. "10") - Max late fees to pay

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - Template Id
- altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- name* string - Name of the Template
- businessDetails* object - Business Details
  - logoUrl string - Business Logo URL
  - name string - Business Name
  - phoneNo string - Business Phone Number
  - address object - Business Address
    - addressLine1 string - Address Line 1
    - addressLine2 string - Address Line 2
    - city string - City
    - state string - State
    - countryCode string - Country Code
    - postalCode string - Postal Code
  - website string - Business Website Link
  - customValues string[] - Custom Values
- currency* string - Currency
- discount object - Discount
  - value number (default: 0) - Discount Value
  - type* string (enum: percentage | fixed; default: percentage) - Discount type
  - validOnProductIds string[] - Product Ids on which discount is applicable
- items* string[] - Invoice Items
- invoiceNumberPrefix string - prefix for invoice number
- total* number - Total Amount
- createdAt* string - created at
- updatedAt* string - updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Void invoice
POST /invoices/{invoiceId}/void
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/invoices/{invoiceId}/void
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/invoices/void-invoice | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/invoices/void-invoice.md

API to delete invoice by invoice id

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices.write
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- invoiceId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Invoice Id

Request body (required) (application/json) VoidInvoiceDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - location Id / company Id based on altType
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - Invoice Id
- status* string (enum: draft | sent | payment_processing | paid | void | partially_paid) - Invoice Status
- liveMode* boolean - Live Mode
- amountPaid* number - Amount Paid
- altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- name* string - Name of the invoice
- businessDetails* object - Business Details
- invoiceNumber* number - Invoice Number
- currency* string - Currency
- contactDetails* object - Contact Details
- issueDate* string - Issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format
- dueDate* string - Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format
- discount object - Discount
- invoiceItems* string[] - Invoice Items
- total* number - Total Amount
- title* string - Title
- amountDue* number - Total Amount Due
- createdAt* string - created at
- updatedAt* string - updated at
- automaticTaxesEnabled boolean - Automatic taxes enabled for the Invoice
- automaticTaxesCalculated boolean - Is Automatic taxes calculated for the Invoice items
- paymentSchedule object - split invoice into payment schedule summing up to full invoice amount

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Bad Request) application/json:
- (no schema)
